title: SFTP accounts configuration
description: Schema for config_schemas/accounts.yaml and accounts.json. `public` permission requires explicit public_acknowledged: true and is never the default.

username.description: POSIX-style login name: lowercase, starts with letter or underscore, max 32 chars.

permission.description: read_only = download only; read_write = upload + download; public = anonymous-style access, NEVER default, requires public_acknowledged: true.

public_acknowledged.description: Explicit operator acknowledgement. MUST be true when permission is public; schema enforces via allOf/if/then below.

uid.description: Numeric UID inside the container; host home dir must be owned by this UID (docs/research/mvp/MVP.md lines 117-132).

gid.description: Numeric GID inside the container; same ownership contract as uid.

home.description: Path INSIDE the container. With ./data bind-mounted at /sftp_data, home is /sftp_data/<username> (MVP.md line 73).

enabled.description: Disabled accounts are kept in config but not rendered to users.conf.
